headroom_definitions.coefficient_headroom_gain: raw metric delta: Render-Refined Coefficient - SVD Endpoint
headroom_definitions.direction_normalized_improvement: reported separately: baseline-method for lower-is-better metrics and method-baseline for higher-is-better metrics
headroom_definitions.full_residual_gain: raw metric delta: Full-Residual Render Optimization - Teacher Endpoint
headroom_definitions.span_recovery_denominator_rule: undefined when Teacher_error-FullResidual_error<=0; emit null plus reason, never fabricate zero or a ratio
headroom_definitions.teacher_headroom_gain: raw metric delta: Render-Refined Coefficient - Teacher Endpoint

primary_denominator.garment_macro_weighting: equal weight for each of five garments
primary_denominator.rotation_weighting: equal weight for each of four rotations
primary_denominator.unit: one garment x one rotation held-out test observation

primary_endpoint_rule: selected positive-anchor candidate at step 300; no checkpoint selection

render_quality.boundary_f: 3x3 erosion XOR boundary with tolerance max(1,floor(0.005*min(H,W)+0.5)); higher is better
render_quality.identity_metric: protected-mask mean absolute RGB difference against Base Avatar render; lower is better
render_quality.lpips: VGG LPIPS v0.1 on garment bbox plus 5 percent, aspect-preserving resize and zero pad to 256x256; lower is better
render_quality.protected_lpips: LPIPS inside target_protected_mask against Base Avatar render; lower is better
render_quality.psnr: masked RGB PSNR; exact zero MSE is the string Infinity; higher is better
render_quality.rgb_mae: masked mean absolute RGB error inside target_clothing_mask; lower is better
render_quality.silhouette_iou: alpha>=0.5 versus target_foreground_mask>=0.5; higher is better
render_quality.ssim: masked 11x11 Gaussian SSIM on garment bbox; higher is better

reporting.uncertainty: paired bootstrap over the 20 garment-rotation cells with garment and rotation labels retained; 10000 deterministic resamples, seed 20260724

safety.identity_contamination: manual grade >0 on any protected identity region
safety.review_policy: review every one of the 20 selected primary test cells for every primary method; no cherry-picking
